name: justjpeg
description: Convert Apple HEIC photos and camera RAW files to JPEG or PNG, thousands at a time.

scripts.icon: npm run icon:svg && npm run icon:raster && npm run icon:icns
scripts.icon:png: npm run icon:svg && npm run icon:raster
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icon && npm run bundle && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run icon:ensure && npm run bundle && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist: npm run icon && npm run bundle && electron-builder --mac --win
scripts.test: node test/paths.test.mjs && node test/show.test.mjs && node test/pixels.test.mjs && node test/engine.test.mjs && node test/tiff.test.mjs && node test/licences.test.mjs && node test/cli.test.mjs && node test/raw.test.mjs && node test/contract.test.mjs && node test/skill.test.cjs && node test/linux-launcher.test.cjs && npm run bundle && node scripts/electron.cjs test/selftest.cjs && node scripts/electron.cjs test/ui.test.cjs && node scripts/electron.cjs test/window.test.cjs
scripts.test:window: npm run bundle && node scripts/electron.cjs test/window.test.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icon:ensure && npm run bundle && electron-builder --linux
